question: What realization arises from immersion in the strength of each principle?
premises: Each principle has its own strength
One can enter into that strength
All things can be seen as one form
inference: Immersion in the strength of each principle reveals a single form pervading all things.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject experiencing this realization is supplied by context
plain_english: From entering the strength of each principle, one realizes that which has one form in all things.
